name: Guardian: an equipped thrown weapon stays equipped after a relog
contract: Issue #13221: Guardians are granted Thrown (skill 176, spell 2567) by the CoA proficiency data, but
SkillRaceClassInfo 233, the only row for skill 176, allowed classes 4, 10 and 12 only. At login _LoadSkills
dropped the skill as invalid for the class, so _LoadInventory could not re-equip the thrown weapon and mailed
it before the login hook granted Thrown again. Expected: a level 24 Guardian equips Ascended Throwing Knives
(28979) in the ranged slot (17), and after a relog the knives are still in slot 17 and were not mailed.

steps.label: SETUP: the thrown weapon is equipped in the ranged slot
DISCRIMINATING: the thrown weapon is still equipped after the relog
DISCRIMINATING: the thrown weapon was not mailed back
Thrown is still known after the relog
